summary: Cerenome, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing a September 4, 2026 securities purchase agreement with an institutional investor for senior secured convertible notes totaling $21,276,596 in original principal, split into $3,191,489 Initial Notes, $2,127,660 Second Notes, and $15,957,447 Additional Notes. Initial closing expected on or about September 10, 2026; Second Notes upon registration effectiveness; Additional Notes at future closings. Offered under Section 4(a)(2)/Rule 506(b) exemption, convertible into common stock. Watch dilution, overhang, and Nasdaq compliance.
